queries.title: Adopted against actual operating expense, by department and fiscal year
queries.method: Per department and fiscal year (1 July to 30 June, named by the year it ends; a two-digit report_fy is read as 2000 plus that number): adopted is the sum of amount in Budget fixture where budget_cycle is adopted and account_number begins with 5 (the City's expense accounts); actual is the sum of amount in Actuals fixture over the same accounts. Departments are matched on dept_name without regard to letter case. Only fiscal years with rows in both tables are read; a year the actuals table does not cover is not counted. The rows returned are a department with "homeless" in its name, Police and Environmental Services, and any department-year with adopted rows and no row of any account in the actuals table; one whose adopted rows sum to more than zero is listed. A department-year is reported when actual is at least 10% below adopted and at least $1,000,000 below; both are fixed yardsticks, not a statistical test. A department-year with no actual rows is listed as having none, which is not spending of zero. Adopted is the original appropriation, not the revised budget: a transfer or a change made during the year is in neither figure. An amount not spent may have been carried forward, moved to another department or returned to its fund; these tables do not say which, and nothing here says the money was put to another use.
queries.sql:
WITH adopted_lines AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("dept_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS department, TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) AS report_fy, TRY_CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE) AS amount
 FROM "analysis_budget" WHERE LOWER(TRIM(CAST("budget_cycle" AS VARCHAR))) = 'adopted' AND CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%'
), adopted AS (
 SELECT LOWER(department) AS department_key, MIN(department) AS department, CASE WHEN report_fy BETWEEN 0 AND 99 THEN 2000 + report_fy ELSE report_fy END AS fiscal_year, SUM(amount) AS adopted_expense, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount IS NULL) AS unreadable_adopted
 FROM adopted_lines WHERE report_fy IS NOT NULL AND department IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 3
), actual_lines AS (
 SELECT LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("dept_name" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS department_key, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 99 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) END AS fiscal_year, TRY_CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE) AS amount, CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' AS expense
 FROM "analysis_actuals"
), actual AS (
 SELECT department_key, fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS actual_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE expense) AS actual_expense_rows, SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE expense) AS actual_expense,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE expense AND amount IS NULL) AS unreadable_actual
 FROM actual_lines WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL AND department_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2
), actual_years AS (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year FROM actual_lines WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL
), compared AS (
 SELECT adopted.department, adopted.fiscal_year, adopted_expense, unreadable_adopted, actual_rows, actual_expense_rows, actual_expense, unreadable_actual, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(adopted.department), 'homeless') OR LOWER(adopted.department) IN ('police', 'environmental services'), FALSE) AS followed
 FROM adopted JOIN actual_years ON actual_years.fiscal_year = adopted.fiscal_year
  LEFT JOIN actual ON actual.department_key = adopted.department_key AND actual.fiscal_year = adopted.fiscal_year
), span AS (SELECT MIN(fiscal_year) AS first_covered_year, MAX(fiscal_year) AS last_covered_year, COUNT(*) AS department_years FROM compared)
SELECT compared.*, first_covered_year, last_covered_year, department_years
FROM compared CROSS JOIN span WHERE followed OR actual_rows IS NULL ORDER BY department, fiscal_year

queries.title: Adopted against actual overtime, by department and fiscal year
queries.method: Overtime accounts are the account numbers in Budget fixture that begin with 5 (the City's expense accounts) and whose account label contains "overtime"; account numbers are compared as whole numbers, so 500128 and 500128.0 are one account. Per department and fiscal year (1 July to 30 June, named by the year it ends; a two-digit report_fy is read as 2000 plus that number): adopted overtime is the sum of amount in Budget fixture where budget_cycle is adopted and the account is an overtime account; actual overtime is the sum of amount in Actuals fixture over the same account numbers, whatever the label there. Departments are matched on dept_name without regard to letter case. Only fiscal years with rows in both tables are read, and only department-years with an adopted overtime row: a department with overtime in the actuals and no adopted overtime line is not listed. The rows returned are a department with "homeless" in its name, Police and Environmental Services, and the 10 department-years with most actual overtime. A department-year is reported when actual overtime is at least 10% above adopted overtime and at least $1,000,000 above; both are fixed yardsticks, not a statistical test. A department-year with no actual rows, or with rows and none in an overtime account, is listed as such, which is not overtime of zero. Overtime accounts are the expense account numbers whose label in the budget table contains "overtime"; an actuals row is counted by its account number, whatever its label there, and overtime booked to another account is in neither figure. Adopted is the original appropriation, not the revised budget: a transfer made during the year to pay for overtime is in neither figure. Nothing here says why the overtime was worked or whether it was authorised.
queries.sql:
WITH ot_accounts AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) AS account_number FROM "analysis_budget"
 WHERE CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' AND COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("account" AS VARCHAR)), 'overtime'), FALSE) AND TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
), adopted_lines AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("dept_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS department, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 99 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) END AS fiscal_year, TRY_CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE) AS amount, CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) || ' ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("account" AS VARCHAR)), ''), '(no label)') AS account_line
 FROM "analysis_budget" WHERE LOWER(TRIM(CAST("budget_cycle" AS VARCHAR))) = 'adopted' AND TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) IN (SELECT account_number FROM ot_accounts)
), adopted AS (
 SELECT LOWER(department) AS department_key, MIN(department) AS department, fiscal_year, SUM(amount) AS adopted_overtime, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount IS NULL) AS unreadable_adopted,
  STRING_AGG(DISTINCT account_line, ', ' ORDER BY account_line) AS adopted_accounts
 FROM adopted_lines WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL AND department IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 3
), actual_lines AS (
 SELECT LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("dept_name" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS department_key, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 99 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) END AS fiscal_year, TRY_CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE) AS amount, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) IN (SELECT account_number FROM ot_accounts), FALSE) AS overtime,
  CAST(TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) AS VARCHAR) || ' ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("account" AS VARCHAR)), ''), '(no label)') AS account_line
 FROM "analysis_actuals"
), actual AS (
 SELECT department_key, fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS actual_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE overtime) AS actual_ot_rows, SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE overtime) AS actual_overtime,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE overtime AND amount IS NULL) AS unreadable_actual, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT account_line, ', ' ORDER BY account_line) FILTER (WHERE overtime) AS actual_accounts
 FROM actual_lines WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL AND department_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2
), actual_years AS (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year FROM actual_lines WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL
), compared AS (
 SELECT adopted.department, adopted.fiscal_year, adopted_overtime, unreadable_adopted, adopted_accounts, actual_rows, actual_ot_rows, actual_overtime, unreadable_actual, actual_accounts, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(adopted.department), 'homeless') OR LOWER(adopted.department) IN ('police', 'environmental services'), FALSE) AS followed
 FROM adopted JOIN actual_years ON actual_years.fiscal_year = adopted.fiscal_year
  LEFT JOIN actual ON actual.department_key = adopted.department_key AND actual.fiscal_year = adopted.fiscal_year
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY actual_overtime DESC NULLS LAST, department, fiscal_year) AS position FROM compared
), span AS (SELECT MIN(fiscal_year) AS first_covered_year, MAX(fiscal_year) AS last_covered_year, COUNT(*) AS department_years FROM compared)
SELECT ranked.*, first_covered_year, last_covered_year, department_years
FROM ranked CROSS JOIN span WHERE followed OR position <= 10 ORDER BY department, fiscal_year

queries.title: Settlement and public-liability claim accounts, by fiscal year
queries.method: Rows of Actuals fixture whose account label contains "Negotiated Settlement" or begins "Claims-Pub Liab", summed per fiscal year and department for the 5 latest fiscal years in the table. Lease settlements and workers' compensation claims are other accounts and are left out. Each year is given with the number of departments that have a row in these accounts and the number of departments in the table that year; the 3 largest departments are named, with a department with "homeless" in its name, Police and Environmental Services when they have such a row. A year or department with no row in these accounts is said to have none, which is not an amount of zero. The yearly figures are not compared with each other: on the file retrieved 2026-10-05 the Negotiated Settlement account has rows from 1 department in fiscal 2021 and 2022 and 38 in fiscal 2023, so a difference between years can be a change in where the City records a payment. The accounts record what was booked to a department's ledger, not the cases, the claimants or the reasons.
queries.sql:
WITH lines AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("dept_name" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS department, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 99 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) END AS fiscal_year, TRY_CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE) AS amount, LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("account" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS label
 FROM "analysis_actuals"
), years AS (
 SELECT fiscal_year, COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(department)) AS departments_in_table FROM lines WHERE fiscal_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC LIMIT 5
), settled AS (
 SELECT fiscal_year, department, SUM(amount) AS department_amount, COUNT(*) AS department_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE amount IS NULL) AS unreadable
 FROM lines WHERE (CONTAINS(label, 'negotiated settlement') OR label LIKE 'claims-pub liab%') AND department IS NOT NULL AND fiscal_year IN (SELECT fiscal_year FROM years) GROUP BY 1, 2
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year ORDER BY ABS(department_amount) DESC NULLS LAST, department) AS position, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year) AS departments_reporting,
  SUM(department_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year) AS year_amount, SUM(department_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year) AS year_rows, SUM(unreadable) OVER (PARTITION BY fiscal_year) AS unreadable_amounts,
  COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(department), 'homeless') OR LOWER(department) IN ('police', 'environmental services'), FALSE) AS followed
 FROM settled
)
SELECT years.fiscal_year, departments_in_table, departments_reporting, year_amount, year_rows, unreadable_amounts, department, department_amount, department_rows, position, followed
FROM years LEFT JOIN ranked ON ranked.fiscal_year = years.fiscal_year AND (position <= 3 OR followed)
ORDER BY years.fiscal_year DESC, position

queries.title: Overtime paid, by employer and department
queries.method: Rows of Pay fixture, one per position held as the State Controller publishes it (no names; a person who held two positions is two rows). Per EmployerName with at least 100 rows: the sums of OvertimePay and RegularPay, and the count of positions whose OvertimePay is $100,000 or more. Per DepartmentOrSubdivision: the same sums and overtime as a share of regular pay, for the 5 departments with most overtime and for a department with "homeless" in its name, Police and Environmental Services; a share is stated with at least 30 positions. At most 3 employers are described: the budget's city first, then by number of rows. A row with no overtime figure adds nothing to a sum and is counted apart. Positions whose overtime is above their regular pay are not counted: a low regular figure can be part of a year in the position, and the file does not say which. An employer is read as the city of Budget fixture only when at least 20 of its department names, and at least half of them, are that table's own dept_name values. For that employer each department listed is set beside its adopted overtime: the sum of amount where budget_cycle is adopted, account_number begins with 5 and the account label contains "overtime", for the fiscal year with the pay file's year number and the one after. The pay file covers a calendar year and the budget a fiscal year from 1 July to 30 June, so calendar 2024 is the second half of fiscal 2024 and the first half of fiscal 2025; the figures are beside each other, not the same period. A department with no adopted overtime row is said to have none, which is not an amount of zero. The figures are amounts employers reported to the Controller; nothing here says why overtime was worked or whether it was authorised.
queries.sql:
WITH pay AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("employername" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS employer, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("departmentorsubdivision" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS department, TRY_CAST("regularpay" AS DOUBLE) AS regular_pay, TRY_CAST("overtimepay" AS DOUBLE) AS overtime_pay, TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("year" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) AS pay_year
 FROM "analysis_pay"
), budget_lines AS (
 SELECT LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("dept_name" AS VARCHAR)), '')) AS department_key, CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 0 AND 99 THEN 2000 + TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) ELSE TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(CAST("report_fy" AS VARCHAR) AS DOUBLE) AS INTEGER) END AS fiscal_year, TRY_CAST("amount" AS DOUBLE) AS amount,
  LOWER(TRIM(CAST("budget_cycle" AS VARCHAR))) = 'adopted' AND CAST("account_number" AS VARCHAR) LIKE '5%' AND COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(CAST("account" AS VARCHAR)), 'overtime'), FALSE) AS adopted_overtime
 FROM "analysis_budget"
), budget_departments AS (SELECT DISTINCT department_key FROM budget_lines WHERE department_key IS NOT NULL
), budget_overtime AS (
 SELECT department_key, fiscal_year, SUM(amount) AS adopted_overtime FROM budget_lines WHERE adopted_overtime AND department_key IS NOT NULL AND fiscal_year IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2
), employers AS (
 SELECT employer, COUNT(*) AS positions, SUM(regular_pay) AS regular_pay, SUM(overtime_pay) AS overtime_pay, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE overtime_pay >= 100000) AS high_overtime_positions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE overtime_pay IS NULL) AS positions_without_overtime, COUNT(DISTINCT pay_year) AS pay_years, MIN(pay_year) AS pay_year, COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(department)) AS departments,
  COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(department)) FILTER (WHERE LOWER(department) IN (SELECT department_key FROM budget_departments)) AS budget_departments_matched
 FROM pay WHERE employer IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100
), chosen AS (
 SELECT *, budget_departments_matched >= 20 AND 2 * budget_departments_matched >= departments AS budget_city
 FROM employers ORDER BY budget_city DESC, positions DESC, employer LIMIT 3
), department_pay AS (
 SELECT employer, department, COUNT(*) AS department_positions, SUM(regular_pay) AS department_regular_pay, SUM(overtime_pay) AS department_overtime_pay
 FROM pay WHERE department IS NOT NULL AND employer IN (SELECT employer FROM chosen) GROUP BY 1, 2
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY employer ORDER BY department_overtime_pay DESC NULLS LAST, department) AS position, COALESCE(CONTAINS(LOWER(department), 'homeless') OR LOWER(department) IN ('police', 'environmental services'), FALSE) AS followed FROM department_pay
)
SELECT chosen.employer, positions, regular_pay, overtime_pay, high_overtime_positions, positions_without_overtime, pay_years, pay_year, departments, budget_departments_matched, budget_city,
 ranked.department, department_positions, department_regular_pay, department_overtime_pay, position, followed,
 same_year.adopted_overtime AS adopted_overtime_same_year, next_year.adopted_overtime AS adopted_overtime_next_year,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget_overtime WHERE budget_overtime.fiscal_year = chosen.pay_year) AS overtime_departments_same_year,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM budget_overtime WHERE budget_overtime.fiscal_year = chosen.pay_year + 1) AS overtime_departments_next_year
FROM chosen JOIN ranked ON ranked.employer = chosen.employer AND (position <= 5 OR followed)
 LEFT JOIN budget_overtime AS same_year ON budget_city AND same_year.department_key = LOWER(ranked.department) AND same_year.fiscal_year = chosen.pay_year
 LEFT JOIN budget_overtime AS next_year ON budget_city AND next_year.department_key = LOWER(ranked.department) AND next_year.fiscal_year = chosen.pay_year + 1
ORDER BY budget_city DESC, positions DESC, chosen.employer, position
